'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
****The [[Taliban]] captures its ninth [[Provinces of Afghanistan|provincial]] capital in six days, seizing [[Fayzabad, Badakhshan|Fayzabad]], the capital of [[Badakhshan Province]], amid a rapid advance in northern [[Afghanistan]]. The capture comes as [[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] appeals to [[Warlord|local warlords]] to confront and fight the Taliban. The [[Jihadism|jihadist]] group also takes control of [[Kunduz Airport]], after hundreds of [[Afghan National Security Forces]] personnel in the area surrender with all of their military equipment. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-fighters-capture-eighth-provincial-capital-six-days-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/11/afghanistan-provinces-city-taliban-ghani-mazar-i-sharif-live-news (Al Jazeera)]
****United States officials warn that [[Kabul]] could be isolated and could fall under Taliban control in one to three months. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/us-believes-kabul-could-fall-to-taliban-in-1-3-months20210811140008/ (Asian News International)]
****[[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]] says that the Taliban "will not negotiate with the Afghan government as long as Ghani is the president". Khan further states that he "tried to persuade the Taliban" months ago but that they remained firm on their stance. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-wont-talk-peace-unless-ghani-goes-says-pakistani-pm-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]
****[[Chief of General Staff (Afghanistan)|Chief of General Staff]] of the [[Afghan Armed Forces]] Wali Mohammad Ahmadzai is removed by [[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] as the [[Afghan military]] continues to collapse across the country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-58170847 (BBC News)]
****The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Spain)|Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] confirms that the government will evacuate military personnel, interpreters and other local workers who collaborated with the Spanish mission. [https://www.outlookindia.com/newsscroll/spain-to-evacuate-translators-from-afghanistan/2140956 (''Outlook'')] [https://www.bostonherald.com/2021/08/13/the-latest-un-statement-would-urge-end-to-taliban-offensive/ (''Boston Herald'')]
*[[Tigray War]]
**The leader of the [[Oromo Liberation Front|Oromo Liberation Army]] announces that his group is now supporting [[Tigray Defense Forces|Tigrayan forces]] fighting the [[Ethiopia|government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-only-on-ap-ethiopia-b280e6622d66b7e7f9b12cd1d0041ae8 (Associated Press)]
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**[[Amnesty International]] and [[Project Ploughshares]] accuse the [[Government of Canada|Canadian government]] of violating the [[Arms Trade Treaty]]—which the country signed in 2019—by supplying weapons to [[Saudi Arabia]] that could be used in [[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemen]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/11/canada-violating-intl-law-by-selling-arms-to-saudis-report (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**An investigation by the [[BBC]] into the involvement of the [[Russia|Russian]] [[Wagner Group]] in the war reveals that the group committed several [[war crime]]s, including the intentional killing of [[prisoners of war]] and civilians and the leaving of unmarked mines in civilian areas. The investigation also finds that [[Yevgeny Prigozhin]], a businessman with close ties to [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]], was involved in the group's operations, and that the group likely received weapons and supplies from the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58009514 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Lebanese liquidity crisis]]
**The [[Banque du Liban|Central Bank]] of [[Lebanon]] ends [[Energy subsidy|fuel subsidies]], announcing that it would instead offer "credit lines for fuel imports based on the [[Exchange rate|market price]] for the [[Lebanese pound]]". The decision is likely to result in a significant increase in [[fuel prices]] amid an [[Financial crisis|economic crisis]] in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanese-cbank-says-can-no-longer-subsidise-fuel-report-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
**[[Train driver]]s across [[Germany]] go on strike to demand better pay in light of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany|COVID-19 pandemic]], bringing 700 trains, including 190 [[Rail freight transport|freights]], to a standstill. The strike is expected to end early Friday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/german-train-drivers-decide-further-strikes-next-week-union-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Poland]]'s [[Sejm]] votes 226–218 to pass a bill to strengthen the country's ban on non-[[European Economic Area]] entities from owning a majority stake in [[Mass media in Poland|its broadcast networks]]. The opposition, American politicians, and [[TVN24]], whose ownership by American media company [[Discovery, Inc.]] is being targeted by the bill, criticize it as a restriction on [[free speech]]. It goes to the [[Senate of Poland|Senate]] for a final vote. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-govt-counting-majority-media-reform-says-spokesman-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2021]]
**[[2021 Algeria wildfires]]
***The death toll from the wildfires in northern [[Algeria]] increases to 65, as the country battles a total of 69 fires for the fourth consecutive day. [[President of Algeria|President]] [[Abdelmadjid Tebboune]] declares three days of [[national mourning]] for the wildfire victims. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58174918 (BBC News)]
**[[2021 Calabria wildfires]], [[2021 Sicily wildfires]]
***Two more people are killed by wildfires in [[Calabria]], [[Italy]], bringing the death toll from the fires there to four. Meanwhile, a man is killed by wildfires in [[Sicily]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/aug/13/all-thats-left-are-ashes-italian-communities-count-cost-of-wildfires#:~:text=Five%20people%20are%20confirmed%20to,Paterno%2C%20a%20town%20near%20Catania. (''The Guardian'')]
*At least 10 people are killed and dozens more trapped under debris after a [[landslide]] in a [[Himalayas|Himalayan]] [[districts of India|district]] of [[Himachal Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-58171679 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] lifts most of its [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] measures, allowing banks, shops and shopping malls to reopen and for buses and trains to operate at half capacity despite an increase in the number of [[COVID-19]] infections and [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death]]s from the [[SARS-CoV-2 lineage B.1.617|Lineage B.1.617]] [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/08/11/world/asia/covid-bangladesh.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in mainland China]]
****The [[National Medical Products Administration]] approves China's first mixed-[[COVID-19 vaccine]] trial combining the [[CoronaVac]] vaccine made by [[Sinovac]] and the [[DNA]]-based vaccine made by [[Inovio]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210811-china-approves-first-mixed-vaccine-trial-as-delta-spreads (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports a record 42,541 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 4.28 million. [https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2021/08/11/2552915/coronavirus-in-iran-nearly-7-000-patients-at-hospital-icus (Tasnim News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record 15,812 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://jen.jiji.com/jc/i?g=eco&k=2021081101129 (Jiji Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[South Cotabato]] reports its first case of the [[Lineage B.1.351]] [[SARS-CoV-2 Beta variant|Beta variant]] in a patient who had a history of traveling to [[Davao City]]. [https://www.mindanews.com/top-stories/2021/08/south-cotabato-records-first-case-of-beta-variant/ (MindaNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 2,223 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 216,206. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-koreas-daily-covid-19-cases-hit-record-surpass-2200 (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] surpasses 800,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2021/08/11/thailand-records-21038-covid-19-cases-and-207-deaths (''The Star'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Denmark]]
****[[Denmark]] confirms that it will purchase 280,000 doses of the [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine]] for a total price of 37 million [[Danish krone|crowns]] ($5.84 million) or roughly $20.9 per dose as part of a [[European Union]] agreement with [[Novavax]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/denmark-buy-novavax-vaccines-part-eu-deal-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Spain]]
****The [[Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices]] approves the first round of clinical trials on humans of the PHH-1V vaccine made by Hipra. [https://www.barrons.com/amp/news/spain-approves-human-trials-of-homegrown-virus-vaccine-01628697907 (''Barron's'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Turkey]]
****The number of COVID-19 vaccine doses administered in [[Turkey]] surpasses 80 million, with 50% of people over the age of 18 being fully vaccinated. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-surpasses-80-million-doses-in-covid-19-vaccination-program/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Minister of Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship|Immigration Minister]] [[Marco Mendicino]] announces that [[Canada]] will issue a [[Immunity passport|vaccine passport]] for international travel. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-08-11/canada-planning-covid-19-vaccine-passport-for-international-travel (U.S. News & World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] surpasses three million cases of COVID-19 after reporting a record 22,711 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-08-11/mexico-covid-cases-rise-by-record-as-pandemic-surges-anew (Bloomberg News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] announces that healthcare workers in [[California|the state]] will be [[COVID-19 vaccine mandates in the United States|required]] to receive the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] or undergo [[COVID-19 testing]]. [https://www.ksby.com/news/california-news/gov-newsom-announces-healthcare-workers-must-be-vaccinated (KSBY)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
*****[[Governor of Minnesota|Minnesota Governor]] [[Tim Walz]] announces that state government employees will be required to receive the [[vaccine]] or undergo testing for [[COVID-19]]. [https://apnews.com/article/health-minnesota-coronavirus-pandemic-49d0c70b1e2dc5b6669880d7a7598a63 (Associated Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oregon]]
****[[Governor of Oregon|Oregon Governor]] [[Kate Brown]] reissues a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for indoor public spaces, making [[Oregon]] the 10th [[U.S. state]] to do so. [https://www.newsweek.com/oregon-becomes-tenth-state-reissue-mask-mandate-new-hospitalization-record-set-1618502 (''Newsweek'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
***[[Chile]] begins to administer booster shots of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for people over the age of 55 who have already received two doses of the [[Coronavac]] vaccine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/elderly-chileans-line-up-booster-jabs-reinforce-coronavac-vaccine-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Vanuatu]]'s health authorities warn citizens about the transmission of [[dengue fever]] after 18 cases are reported in [[Port Vila]]. Authorities urge all residents to take precautionary measures. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/448971/vanuatu-hospital-reports-18-dengue-cases (RNZ International)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A [[British people|British]] man working at the [[Embassy of the United Kingdom, Berlin|British embassy]] in [[Berlin]] is arrested by [[Germany|German]] police on suspicion of spying for [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/germany-arrests-british-diplomat-suspected-spying-russia-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]
*A court in Russia opens a criminal investigation into [[Alexei Navalny]], who is already serving a two and a half year sentence for parole violations. The move comes one day after another court opened a criminal investigation into Navalny's allies [[Leonid Volkov (politician)|Leonid Volkov]] and [[Ivan Zhdanov]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/navalny-faces-new-criminal-charges-over-anti-corruption-foundation-say-russian-2021-08-11/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Libyan military|Libyan Military Prosecutor's Office]] issues an arrest warrant for [[Saif al-Islam Gaddafi]], the son of late dictator [[Muammar Gaddafi]] and prospective candidate in the [[2021 Libyan general election|upcoming elections]], for his connections to the [[Wagner Group]]. [https://www.libyaobserver.ly/news/libyas-military-prosecution-orders-saif-al-islam-gaddafis-arrest (''The Libya Observer'')]
*[[Detention of Michael Spavor and Michael Kovrig]]
**A [[China|Chinese]] court jails [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Michael Spavor]] for 11 years over alleged spying. [https://hongkongfp.com/2021/08/11/breaking-chinese-court-jails-canadian-michael-spavor-for-11-years-on-spying-charges/?fbclid=IwAR2DSIC22O7ox3CJAk5q0y1X0mNJb5dKH-eItTi68Lt46pXB5UayX63ZwtA (''Hong Kong Free Press'')]
*[[Pope Francis]] says that he is sorrowful at the news of the Aug. 9 murder of French priest Fr. Olivier Maire. Father Maire, 61, was the [[provincial superior]] of the [[Company of Mary|Montfort Missionaries]]. His murder was announced by France’s Interior Minister [[Gérald Darmanin]]. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/248650/pope-francis-saddened-by-murder-of-french-priest-fr-olivier-maire (Catholic News Agency)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[President of Bougainville]] [[Ishmael Toroama]] says that [[Autonomous Region of Bougainville|the region]] needs to take a [[holistic approach]] in order to gain full independence from [[Papua New Guinea]]. Toromoa pointed towards receiving international aid to build an economy for the region which overwhelmingly [[2019 Bougainvillean independence referendum|voted for independence in a referendum]] in 2019. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/448945/bougainville-president-details-necessary-steps-to-independence (RNZ International)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Climate change in Africa]]
**[[Tunisia]] records its highest ever temperature of 50.3°C (122.3°F) in the city of [[Kairouan]] amid an unprecedented [[heat wave]]. [https://allafrica.com/stories/202108130192.html (AllAfrica)]
*[[Climate change in Europe]]
**Amid an unprecedented [[heat wave]] and ongoing [[2021 Sicily wildfires|wildfires]], authorities on the island of [[Sicily]] report a record temperature of 48.8°C (119.8°F). If verified by the [[World Meteorological Organization]], it would be the highest temperature ever recorded in both [[Italy]] and [[Europe]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58130893 (BBC News)]
*YouTube suspensions, [[COVID-19 misinformation]]
**[[YouTube]] suspends the account of [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Rand Paul]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]-[[Kentucky|KY]]) for one week for spreading misinformation about the effectiveness of [[face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic]]. Paul subsequently states in a tweet that he considers the suspension to be "a badge of honor". [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2021/aug/11/youtube-suspends-rand-paul-covid-masks (''The Guardian'')]
